svg.text: AI employee for Slack. Idea: get it done, fast ('GeckIt' = do it, but quickly). Sketches for choosing, not final assets.
The gecko redrawn mid-sprint, pointed like an arrow.
Speed: a body built as a forward arrow. Keeps today's green gecko.
Risk: at 16 px it turns into a blob; the most literal of the three.
Done. The board deck is in #leadership.
Done. The board deck is in #leadership.
A G whose bar breaks out of the letter: the gecko darts off.
Speed: the task leaves the curl before the circle closes.
Risk: G monograms are common; the eye is the ownable detail.
Done. The board deck is in #leadership.
Done. The board deck is in #leadership.
A check mark whose stroke ends in a gecko's tail curl.
Speed: 'done' is the whole sign, the curl says who did it.
Risk: checks are the task-app cliche; the curl can read as '?'.
Done. The board deck is in #leadership.

Greens: today's app green kept as equity. Wordmarks set in Avenir Next and outlined for the sketch; final type to be drawn. No trademark search done.
